Which Parent Gave It

STS-HS10-L3-BR300-HSSCILIFE-LEC-AAD-01 • HS Life Science Grade 10 • DNA and Chromosomes in Inherited Traits
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
A Lab Experiment Challenge asks one question the plants have to answer for you. Imani's group is running theirs on a cowpea line that came out of the Freedom Seed Library, where okra, sorghum, benne and rice have been saved by hand for generations. Every seed keeper who chose the best plant and saved from it was already running this experiment, one season at a time. This year the offspring pod came out dark red like Parent A, and the group has to say why.
The offspring pod is dark red like Parent A. What would you need to see in the next generation to know Parent B still passed down instructions for pod color?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
